```
##### Display Popups ##### 

bind C-y display-popup \
  -d "#{pane_current_path}" \
  -w 80% \
  -h 80% \
  -E "lazygit"
bind C-n display-popup -E 'bash -i -c "read -p \"Session name: \" name; tmux new-session -d -s \$name && tmux switch-client -t \$name"'
bind C-j display-popup -E "tmux list-sessions | sed -E 's/:.*$//' | grep -v \"^$(tmux display-message -p '#S')\$\" | fzf --reverse | xargs tmux switch-client -t"
bind C-p display-popup -E "ipython"
bind C-f display-popup \
  -w 80% \
  -h 80% \
  -E 'rmpc'
bind C-r display-popup \
  -d "#{pane_current_path}" \
  -w 90% \
  -h 90% \
  -E "ranger"
bind C-z display-popup \
  -w 80% \
  -h 80% \
  -E 'nvim ~/.zshrc'
bind C-g display-popup -E "bash -i ~/.tmux/scripts/chat-popup.sh"
bind C-t display-popup \
  -d "#{pane_current_path}" \
  -w 75% \
  -h 75% \
  -E "zsh"

##### Display Menu ##### 

bind d display-menu -T "#[align=centre]Dotfiles" -x C -y C \
  ".zshrc"            z  "display-popup -E 'nvim ~/.zshrc'" \
  ".tmux.conf"        t  "display-popup -E 'nvim ~/.tmux.conf'" \
  ".sketchybarrc"     s  "display-popup -d "~/.config/sketchybar" -E 'nvim ~/.config/sketchybar/sketchybarrc'" \
  "Exit"              q  ""


# Fzf over keybinds and run selection (these are not working yet. Nested popup problem)

```

     2	
     3	Floating terminal windows for TUI tools, powered by [Snacks.terminal](https://github.com/folke/snacks.nvim/blob/main/docs/terminal.md) (bundled with LazyVim).
     4	
     5	## How It Works
     6	
     7	All TUI keymaps live in `lua/plugins/floating-tui.lua`. Each tool is a single `Snacks.terminal.toggle(cmd, opts)` call — no custom Lua module needed. Snacks handles:
     8	
     9	- Floating window lifecycle (create, show, hide, resize)
    10	- Terminal session persistence (hide with `q`, reopen with same keymap)
    11	- Double-Esc to exit terminal insert mode
    12	- Auto-cleanup when the process exits
    13	
    14	This is the same mechanism behind `<leader>gg` (LazyGit via `Snacks.lazygit()`).
    15	
    16	## Default Keymaps
    17	
    18	| Keymap | Tool | Category |
    19	|--------|------|----------|
    20	| `<leader>gg` | LazyGit | Git (LazyVim built-in) |
    21	| `<leader>zg` | gh dash | Git / GitHub |
    22	| `<leader>zs` | sqlit | Database |
    23	| `<leader>fy` | yazi | File Manager |
    24	| `<leader>zb` | btop | System Monitor |
    25	| `<leader>zd` | lazydocker | Container |
    26	| `<leader>zi` | ipython | REPL |
    27	
    28	Inside a floating TUI window:
    29	
    30	- **Double-Esc** — exit terminal insert mode (back to normal mode)
    31	- **q** (normal mode) — hide the window, process keeps running
    32	- **Same keymap again** — reopen the hidden window
    33	
    34	For the managed `gh-dash` / `diffnav` / `lazygit` setup behind `<leader>zg`, see [Git Diff Workflow](../tools/git_diff_workflow.md).
    35	
    36	## Adding a New TUI
    37	
    38	Add an entry to the `keys` table in `lua/plugins/floating-tui.lua`:
    39	
    40	```lua
    41	{
    42	  "<leader>zX",
    43	  function()
    44	    Snacks.terminal.toggle("mytool", {
    45	      win = { title = " mytool " },
    46	    })
    47	  end,
    48	  desc = "MyTool",
    49	},
    50	```
    51	
    52	### Common Options
    53	
    54	```lua
    55	Snacks.terminal.toggle(cmd, {
    56	  cwd = vim.uv.cwd(),          -- working directory
    57	  cwd = LazyVim.root.git(),    -- or use git root
    58	  env = { FOO = "bar" },       -- environment variables
    59	  auto_close = false,           -- keep window after process exits (for short-lived tools)
    60	  win = {
    61	    title = " tool name ",      -- floating window title
    62	    width = 0.9,                -- 0-1 = ratio, >1 = columns
    63	    height = 0.9,
    64	    border = "rounded",         -- "rounded", "double", "single", "none"
    65	    position = "float",         -- "float" (default for cmd), "bottom", "left", "right"
    66	  },
    67	})

    69	
    70	### Multi-word Commands
    71	
    72	Pass a table for commands with arguments:
    73	
    74	```lua
    75	Snacks.terminal.toggle({ "gh", "dash" }, { ... })
    76	Snacks.terminal.toggle({ "psql", "postgres://localhost/mydb" }, { ... })
    77	```
    78	
    79	### Tools That Exit Quickly
    80	
    81	Some tools (like `sqlit`) may exit and show `[Process exited 0]`. Set `auto_close = false` to keep the window visible so you can inspect output. The next toggle after closing will create a fresh instance.
    82	
    83	### Tools with Vim-like Keybindings
    84	
    85	Tools that use Esc internally (like sqlit's vim mode) work fine with Snacks' **double-Esc** timer — a single Esc goes to the TUI, pressing Esc again within 200ms exits terminal insert mode.
    86	
    87	### Tools That Use `q` to Quit
    88	
    89	By default, Snacks maps `q` in normal mode to **hide** the floating window (process keeps running). However, some TUI tools (like `sqlit`) use `q` as their own quit command, which terminates the process.
    90	
    91	**The conflict:** if you Double-Esc back to Neovim normal mode and press `q`, Snacks hides the window — but if you press `q` while still in terminal insert mode, the TUI receives it and may exit the process entirely.
    92

    95	```lua
    96	Snacks.terminal.toggle("sqlit", {
    97	  win = {
    98	    title = " sqlit ",
    99	    keys = {
   100	      q = false,                              -- disable default q-to-hide
   101	      hide = { "<C-q>", "hide", mode = "n" }, -- use Ctrl-q to hide instead
   102	    },
   103	  },
   104	  auto_close = false,
   105	})
   106	```
   107

   109	- **Double-Esc** — exit terminal insert mode
   110	- **Ctrl-q** (normal mode) — hide the window, process keeps running
   111	- **Same keymap** (e.g. `<leader>zs`) — reopen the hidden window

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-02 06:40:23Z)**_

對，`tmux display-popup` 跟 `Snacks.terminal` 在使用感上很像，都是「臨時叫出一個浮動視窗來跑 TUI / 指令」。但它們不是同一層的東西。

`tmux display-popup` 是 tmux 自己的 overlay，蓋在 pane 上面，適合從任何 shell / app 狀態快速叫出 `lazygit`、`fzf`、新 shell、session picker 這類工具。tmux 官方也明說 popup 是畫在 panes 上方，而且 popup 開著時底下 panes 不會更新。`Snacks.terminal` 則是 Neovim 裡面的 floating terminal；你 repo 內文件也寫得很清楚，它負責 terminal 的建立、隱藏、重開、尺寸管理，還能用同一個 keymap 把同一個 TUI 再叫回來。你現在的設定就是這種模式，例如 `gh dash` / `sqlit` / `yazi` / `btop` 都走 Snacks，在 [floating-tui.md](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/docs/neovim/floating-tui.md#L7) 和 [floating-tui.lua](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/nvim/lua/exact_plugins/floating-tui.lua#L7) 裡已經有。

實務上可以這樣分：
- 要「全 terminal 通用」的快取操作，用 tmux popup。你現在其實已經有類似用法了，例如 `prefix + T` 的 sesh picker 是 tmux popup/fzf 路線，見 [dot_tmux.conf](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_tmux.conf#L116)。
- 要「跟 Neovim 編輯狀態綁很緊」的操作，用 Snacks。像依目前 buffer / git root 開工具、關掉後再回原本編輯流程，Snacks 通常更順。

所以你的理解基本正確：`display-popup` 可以把很多「原本想放在 Snacks 浮窗裡做的快速 TUI」搬到 tmux 層做。差別主要不是外觀，而是作用範圍和整合深度。

來源：
- [tmux manual: `display-popup`](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/tmux.1.html)
- [Snacks terminal docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/folke/snacks.nvim/main/docs/terminal.md)
- [repo docs: floating TUI](file:///Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/docs/neovim/floating-tui.md)
